describe.title: Orders: reserve stock before confirming an order

components.name: order-service
components.role: validates, prices and confirms orders on a worker pool

change.title: Orders: reserve stock before confirming an order
change.description: order-service now reserves stock with inventory-service before it confirms an order. Unit tests pass.
change.diff:
--- a/services/orders/handler.py
+++ b/services/orders/handler.py
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@ def handle_order(request):
     order = validate(request)
     price(order)
+    inventory.reserve(order.items)  # hold stock before confirming
     return confirm(order)

variants.baseline: system without the change, under recorded production traffic
variants.candidate: system with the change applied, under the same traffic
variants.control: change applied, then reverted, under the same traffic
